look_here_first: Dark-centered stellate hairs create a brown-dotted leaf underside; two deeply bifid styles give four terminal branches, and the fruit is effectively one-seeded.

best_field_traits: small annual often branching near the base
dark-centered stellate hairs on lower leaf surface
two deeply bifid styles with four terminal branches
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Croton lindheimerianus lacks the brown-dot hairs and has three styles/six terminal segments; Croton texensis is dioecious with narrow leaves and warty fruit.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Croton lindheimerianus lacks the brown-dot hairs and has three styles/six terminal segments; Croton texensis is dioecious with narrow leaves and warty fruit.
